schema.help: Pollution means exhaust fumes and gases that harm the air and the climate.

options.text: No, it doesn't affect my choices
I think about it now and then
It often affects how I travel

schema.text: Do you think about pollution from vehicles when you choose how to travel?

ar.#Do you think about pollution from vehic: هل تفكر في التلوث الناتج عن المركبات عند اختيار طريقة تنقلك؟
ar.#I think about it now and then: أفكر في ذلك من حين لآخر
ar.#Pollution means exhaust fumes and gases: التلوث يعني عوادم المركبات والغازات التي تضر بالهواء والمناخ.

de.#Do you think about pollution from vehic: Denken Sie an die Luftverschmutzung durch Fahrzeuge, wenn Sie entscheiden, wie Sie unterwegs sind?
de.#I think about it now and then: Ich denke ab und zu daran
de.#I try to use the car less because of it: Ich versuche deshalb, weniger Auto zu fahren
de.#It often affects how I travel: Es beeinflusst oft, wie ich unterwegs bin
de.#No, it doesn't affect my choices: Nein, es beeinflusst meine Entscheidungen nicht
de.#Pollution means exhaust fumes and gases: Gemeint sind Abgase, die der Luft und dem Klima schaden.

en.#Do you think about pollution from vehic: Do you think about pollution from vehicles when you choose how to travel?
en.#I think about it now and then: I think about it now and then
en.#I try to use the car less because of it: I try to use the car less because of it
en.#It often affects how I travel: It often affects how I travel
en.#No, it doesn't affect my choices: No, it doesn't affect my choices
en.#Pollution means exhaust fumes and gases: Pollution means exhaust fumes and gases that harm the air and the climate.

fa.#Do you think about pollution from vehic: وقتی شیوه سفر را انتخاب می‌کنید، به آلودگی ناشی از وسایل نقلیه فکر می‌کنید؟
fa.#I try to use the car less because of it: به همین دلیل سعی می‌کنم کمتر از خودرو استفاده کنم
fa.#It often affects how I travel: اغلب بر شیوه سفر من اثر می‌گذارد
fa.#It sometimes affects my choices: گاهی بر انتخاب‌های من اثر می‌گذارد
fa.#No, it doesn't affect my choices: نه، بر انتخاب‌های من تأثیری ندارد
fa.#Pollution means exhaust fumes and gases: آلودگی یعنی دود و گازهای اگزوز که به هوا و اقلیم آسیب می‌زنند.

fr.#Do you think about pollution from vehic: Pensez-vous à la pollution des véhicules quand vous choisissez comment vous déplacer ?
fr.#I think about it now and then: J'y pense de temps en temps
fr.#I try to use the car less because of it: J'essaie de moins utiliser la voiture pour cette raison
fr.#It often affects how I travel: Cela influence souvent ma façon de me déplacer
fr.#No, it doesn't affect my choices: Non, cela n'influence pas mes choix
fr.#Pollution means exhaust fumes and gases: Par pollution, on entend les gaz d'échappement qui nuisent à l'air et au climat.

hu.#Do you think about pollution from vehic: Gondol a járművek okozta szennyezésre, amikor kiválasztja, hogyan utazik?
hu.#I try to use the car less because of it: Emiatt igyekszem kevesebbet használni az autót
hu.#Pollution means exhaust fumes and gases: A szennyezés a kipufogógázokat és más gázokat jelenti, amelyek ártanak a levegőnek és az éghajlatnak.

it.#Do you think about pollution from vehic: Quando scegli come spostarti, pensi all'inquinamento dei veicoli?
it.#I try to use the car less because of it: Cerco di usare meno l'auto per questo motivo
it.#It often affects how I travel: Spesso influisce su come mi sposto
it.#It sometimes affects my choices: A volte influisce sulle mie scelte
it.#No, it doesn't affect my choices: No, non influisce sulle mie scelte
it.#Pollution means exhaust fumes and gases: Per inquinamento si intendono i fumi di scarico e i gas che fanno male all'aria e al clima.

tr.#Do you think about pollution from vehic: Nasıl yolculuk edeceğinize karar verirken araçların neden olduğu kirliliği düşünüyor musunuz?
tr.#I try to use the car less because of it: Bu yüzden otomobili daha az kullanmaya çalışırım
tr.#It often affects how I travel: Nasıl yolculuk ettiğimi sık sık etkiler
tr.#Pollution means exhaust fumes and gases: Kirlilik, havaya ve iklime zarar veren egzoz dumanları ve gazlar demektir.
